title: Isolate Cad Play Viewport Cameras
description: CAD play quad windows share camera state: orbiting or zooming in one pane (e.g. concrete asset / structure-classic) causes all other viewports to jump. Root cause is shared modelDefinitionRevision triggering mesh reload + autoFitBehavior changes across panes.
summary: Fixed linked CAD play quad viewports. (1) Camera jump: use per-pane viewModel.revision instead of global modelDefinitionRevision for document/tessellation; autoFitBehavior changes scoped per pane. (2) Models only appearing after clicking each window: restored autoFitBehavior=changes so async committed meshes trigger per-pane camera fit; added modelsLoadEpoch bumped on fixture/load so all panes refresh documentModel and flushedModels together; committedMeshesKeepPrevious on cad play tessellation; CommittedMeshesReadyInvalidate when meshes first load.
